prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Try Out Your Companion Desktop Controls", "Practice calling, moving, and chatting with your pet right here on your desktop screen.", "Test Pet Commands"]
1: ["Choose Your Companion Vibe", "Select a personality archetype to tailor your desktop companion experience.", "Playful Explorer", "Calm Study Buddy"]
2: ["Save Your Companion to the Cloud", "Link your account now to ensure your pet is backed up and never lost across sessions."]
3: ["Sign Your Official Desktop Companion Certificate", "Give your companion a name and sign the adoption agreement to lock in your cloud backup.", "Pet Name", "Sign Certificate"]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay & Display Permissions", "If your desktop companion does not automatically appear on top of other windows, check your system permission settings.", "Desktop overlay relies on system screen draw permissions."]
5: ["Press Alt+P (or Cmd+P) anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet.", "Hotkey: Alt+P / Cmd+P"]
6: ["Select a Path & Unlock Exclusive Starter Accessories", "Pick your setup style now to claim a free accessory item for your desktop pet.", "Free Starter Hat Unlocked"]
7: ["Custom Photo Upload & Preset Comparison", "Preview how your custom photo renders on your 3D pet alongside standard models.", "Upload Photo"]
8: ["Secure Your Pet & Enable Cross-Device Sync", "Signing in links your pet personality and unlocks to your email so your pet is never lost during updates.", "Your pet progress saves to cloud automatically upon sign in."]
9: ["Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Companion", "Watch your pet roam, play, and assist on your desktop.", "Begin Setup"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and exclusive items
Asks for personal information (custom photo upload)
